EntrySet.label: AI
EntrySet.entry: This feature requires a GPU with at least %GB% GB of memory: an NVIDIA graphics card (Windows / Linux, the PyTorch CUDA build is installed for its driver) or an Apple Silicon Mac. It does not work on the CPU nor with integrated Intel / AMD graphics.

An AI clip is already being generated.
Describe the video to generate (subject, action, setting, light, camera movement...):
First use: about %GB% GB are downloaded and installed into the Models folder of 3Denlive (the model, Python and PyTorch).

The video is in 2D, written into the AI folder of the project with its prompt, and added to the media list. Add the "2D+depthmap->stereo" processor to its clip to turn it into 3D. The generation takes from several minutes to more than an hour depending on the GPU.
Wan2.2 model: Apache-2.0 licence (commercial use allowed). The generation runs on this computer: nothing is sent over the network.
Reference image (optional): the video starts from this image and animates it according to the prompt. It is cropped to the ratio of the video, whose orientation follows the image.
None: the video is generated from the text only
Installing PyTorch and diffusers (several GB, once)...

EntrySet.label: DepthConvert
EntrySet.entry: This clip has no depth map. Compute it from the image or the video (artificial intelligence, Depth Anything V2)?
This processor has no depth map yet. Compute the depth maps of both views from the clip (artificial intelligence, Depth Anything V2)?
A depth map computation is already running.
The depth map computation is not available on this platform (ONNX Runtime: Windows x64, Linux x64 / arm64, macOS Apple Silicon only).
The depth map can only be computed for an image or a video file.
Choose the model that computes the depth (Depth Anything V2). It is downloaded once, into the Models folder of 3Denlive.
Apache-2.0 licence: free, commercial use allowed
CC-BY-NC-4.0 licence: non commercial use only
The ONNX Runtime engine (%MB% MB) is also downloaded once.

The depth map is written next to the image or video, with the same name followed by _3eDepthMap (in the WorkCache folder of the project if that folder is read-only). It is associated with the clip, reused, and packed with the project.
Video: the depth of every frame is computed, this may take a long time.
Runs on the GPU if there is one with at least %GB% GB free, else on the CPU (fast enough on the CPU too)
